title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Obay in the Municipality of Polanco, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, into a Barrio to be Known as Barrio Obay
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Obay in the Municipality of Polanco, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, into a Barrio to be Known as Barrio Obay

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2605_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Obay in the Municipality of Polanco, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is converted into a barrio to be known as Barrio Obay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, June 21, 1959
